resources.string: Native product preview · Status only\nThis build does not capture, recognize pages or perform Rewards tasks.
Only status and integration requirements are available. Stock task, permission, schedule and remote-service routes are not integrated.
Approved once; durable claim still required
The historical diagnostic approval does not cover this build. This page cannot grant, reset or reuse screenshot authorization.

The replaceable one-shot interface and coordinator are included, but no capture or OCR adapter is bound. The preserved Maa streaming backend has unresolved stop and ownership issues and is not integrated as a safe backend.
Matches legacy property allowlist; still not ready

Legacy limits remain Android 15 / API 35, ranchu and sdk_gphone. Only app-readable Build properties are compared, not device attestation. Remote shell UID 2000 is not verified. This does not authorize Android 14 operation.
Read-only resource hashes and task restrictions remain in the preserved source. This page does not extract resources, start privileged processes or perform execution preflight.
Finished independent Bing diagnostic · Historical record

One independent attempt at 2026-11-10 18:35 UTC reported text present only, without validating page contents, values or points. Worker Binder death followed, and the consumed claim survived restart. This is a build-time record, not live device evidence. Binder death alone does not prove external shell exit.
Technical readiness still needs fresh approval

A reviewed read-only backend, device and resource checks, fresh scope-specific approval and a durable one-use claim before dispatch are required. Ready for future approval does not mean authorized. This build has no approval or start path.
Stop requested does not mean stopped

Timeout, cancellation return, an available result or Binder death does not replace full cleanup evidence. A future backend must confirm producer quiescence, consumer release and external-child exit. Missing evidence keeps cleanup unconfirmed and blocks restart.

The historical diagnostic used full-screen capture. Before/after window checks are not atomic or single-app isolation. Read-only still has risks. Android, ART, drivers, crash dumps and native libraries may retain data.
